items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin will play (FINAL UPDATE); active after GTD hamstring.
items.why: ETR final; Schefter listed in actives; limited snaps possible.
items.implication: Flex/WR3 viable with Daniels returning; Diggs out boosts role.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets up without Diggs; monitor snap share.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty is a go after hopeful GTD status on plantar/ankle; elevated backup in case.
items.why: Rapoport update after pregame workout; ETR FINAL will play.
items.implication: Start as RB1 but monitor workload limits possible.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson active; Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. inactive.
items.why: Rapoport/Schefter official actives; Jefferson wanted to play in Louisiana.
items.implication: Jefferson must-start; Addison sit, volume funnels to Jefferson.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Jefferson without Addison.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja’Marr Chase, listed questionable, will play vs Dolphins.
items.why: Schefter report; corroborated by ETR final updates.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; full workload expected.
items.opportunity: Snap share and targets remain elite.

items.text: Bengals WR Tee Higgins, listed questionable, will play vs Dolphins.
items.why: Paired with Chase confirmation from Schefter/ETR.
items.implication: Solid WR2/flex start; shares targets with Chase.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: NOT EXPECTED McConkey/Caleb/Dowdle/MHJ/Slayton/Palmer; GTD Jefferson-Addison/Jeanty/McLaurin/DJ Moore; EXPECTED Flowers/Tate/Stevenson/Kamara/Keenan. Later finals Chase/Higgins/Jeanty/McLaurin play, Jefferson expected/Addison not.
items.why: Core ETR Sunday AM pulse aligned Schefter/Rap.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel out for remainder of game with hamstring.
items.implication: No more fantasy points; monitor for next week.
items.opportunity: Boost to remaining SF pass-catchers/Kittle in two-minute.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers officially active (expected earlier on foot).
items.implication: Start as WR2/3 with Huntley; solid volume.

items.text: Cardinals trade WR Marvin Harrison Jr. + 2027 7th to Texans for 2027 2nd + 6th; MHJ inactive for ARI, fresh start in HOU with Stroud/Collins.
items.implication: MHJ long-term upgrade in better offense; short-term ARI WR vacuum (Wilson etc.); HOU WR room crowded short-term.
items.opportunity: Immediate depth for HOU; ROS boost MHJ, slight hit Collins share.

items.text: Jaylen Warren passes every test (advanced/eye) as Ekeler-esque workhorse; coaching staffs refused despite Dowdle split pre-injury, now clear path.
items.why: Levitan player-specific praise post-Dowdle out (ETR not expected).
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex ROS/start with Dowdle out.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, third-down, goal-line all elevated.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot).
Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury.
items.implication: Sit; opens more work for other HOU backs.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially inactive; chance to play next week.
items.implication: Sit; backup QB starts, impacts CHI pass catchers.

items.text: Rico Dowdle not expected to play (summary); later confirmed out context for PIT.
Late Sunday injuries watching: Montgomery (groin), Judkins (foot), Henderson (ankle), Deebo (hamstring), others including Hockenson/Tre Harris.
items.why: ETR postgame/injury list; Levitan noted impactful ones.
items.implication: Next-week flags; midgame Deebo already out.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.implication: Priority add in GB backfield for upside/handcuff.
items.opportunity: Potential role expansion if Jacobs limited.

items.text: 49ers TE George Kittle officially active despite illness; expected to play.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/two-minute usage high; Deebo out boosts further.

items.text: Vikings TE T.J. Hockenson (concussion) downgraded to out.
items.implication: TE streamers up in MIN; Jefferson volume secure.
